Total dispatches increase (8*num_chunks collectives) but latency can be hidden through pipelining. Trades dispatch count for potential overlap and improved hardware utilization.

strategies.name: Two-Phase Reduce-Scatter then All-Gather

Performs 8 reduce_scatter + 8 all_gather = 16 collective dispatches but each operates on asymmetric payload sizes. Trades collective count for reduced per-rank working set.

Reduces to 1 collective dispatch with 8× payload but may exceed memory bandwidth or message size limits.
